{{short description|French mathematician}}
{{distinguish|François Châtelet (philosopher)}}
'''François Châtelet''' (11 September 1912 – 19 April 1987, age 75) was a mathematician at the [[Université de Besançon]] who introduced the [[Weil–Châtelet group]] and [[Châtelet surface]]s. His father was the mathematician [[Albert Châtelet]].
